description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) for six different datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—comparing the performance of four variants of the MADLLM model: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (brown). The horizontal axis is labeled “Dataset” and lists the datasets in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each dataset, four bars are grouped side-by-side, each representing one variant of the model. The tallest bars are for the PSM dataset, where MADLLM achieves an F1 score of approximately 98%, followed closely by MADLLM w/o feature embedding at about 97%. The shortest bars are for the WADI dataset, where MADLLM w/o feature embedding scores around 62% and MADLLM w/o prompt pool scores around 63%. In general, the MADLLM variant (green) performs best across most datasets, while the variants without specific components consistently score lower than the full model. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar.
